text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003ECKD WARD.\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E38yr old male , works in a book stall\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHAS BEEN ON DIALYSIS SINCE 6YRS.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EYesterday night he came with\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;c\/o shorteness of breath ,pedal edema, abdominal distension and got admitted.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe cannot walk on his own, needs support.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EYesterday's vitals:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBp:140\/90mmhg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERR: 28cpm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESpo2: 98% RA.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EToday he has a dialysis session.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHis last dialysis was about a month ago\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe comes under day care basis usually.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe has AV fistula to his left arm.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/O HTN since 2yrs on tab. NICARDIA 20mg.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EToday mrng at 9:00am his\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBP : 190\/110mmhg\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERR: 26cpm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAfter nebulization, sob decreased to some extent. RR: 20cpm.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAfter giving NICARDIA 20mg oral ,\u0026nbsp; after 1hr his BP came down to 150\/90mmhg.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/O alcohol since 20yrs, every alternate day around whiskey 200ml\/day. Now since 2-3yrs he stopped consuming alcohol.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe is a smoker since 20yrs, smokes around 20-30 cigarettes per day, before 6yrs.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENOW HE SMOKES AROUND 10-12 CIGARETTES PER DAY\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"letter-spacing: 0.2px;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"letter-spacing: 0.2px;\"\u003ENo H\/O DM, EPILEPSY, THYROID, TB ASTHMA.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPAST HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOccupation: book seller\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMarried. Has a healthy daughter with age of 10yrs.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe was apparently asymptomatic 6yrs back.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHis daily routine was, he used to wake up around 7, undergo his daily natural activites, goes to book stall around 10, comes to house for lunch in the afternoon, goes back to work again. Though he was regular to his work, before 6yrs. He used to stay at home for almost 2-3 days a week.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EIn the evening with his friends around his house, consumes alcohol around 250ml a day whiskey.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESmokes around 20-30cigarretes per day.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENow he is not working, stays at home.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBefore 6yrs, he went\u0026nbsp; to nearby hospital with complaints of loss of appetite since 1mon , pain abdomen, shorteness of breath , pedal edema.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EGot diagnosed as renal failure and has been sent to our hospital for dialysis.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESince then he has been under dialysis.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EIn between he used to have episodes of shorteness of breath and pedal edema, got relieved after dialysis and by taking regular medication.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBefore 2yrs he was been hospitalized with complaints of grade 4 shorteness of breath, pedal edema and pain abdomen.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe has been diagnosed DENOVO HTN.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn regular medication.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EIn his xray , plueral effusion was noted in left side.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3 times pleural tap was done.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1time PRBC Transfusion was done\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eand got discharged.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EContinued dialysis sessions on day care basis.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBefore 2months ,he developed abdominal distension, gradual in onset , progressive, not relieving.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EINVESTIGATIONS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
